scope: DeepSeek text-only A/B for first-draft mode. No Yunwu, WellAPI, DreamMaker, music, cover, or video generation.

judge_rubric.standard: Gold-award-level direction, but scored for whether the first draft is understandable, singable, grounded in Yanyun, and worth user editing.

per_case_review.reason: Full brief gave the most complete waiting/returning emotional arc. Direct was usable and much faster, but slightly simpler. Conditional skipped brief and introduced more scattered lore references.

Direct kept the player memory clean and concrete. Full brief drifted toward a broader nostalgia frame. Conditional was singable but pulled in extra relationship imagery that made the place memory less pure.
Conditional kept the ordinary-player scale and avoided turning the character into a savior. Full brief was serviceable but slightly sports-hero shaped. Direct was clear but less memorable.
Full brief produced the most restrained small-scene song. Direct and conditional were usable, but leaned toward a list of warm scene objects.
Full brief best handled the light-to-sad turn. Direct was understandable but generic. Conditional had a stronger memory frame than direct but still too clean.
Direct had the strongest dirty-street texture and bottom-level voice. Full brief was more polished and still good. Conditional was a little too orderly.
Conditional found the strongest speaking voice and daily care details. Full brief was correct but more distant. Direct was grounded but less song-like.
This is the strongest argument for conditional brief. The input is short and entity-heavy; conditional triggered brief and produced the coldest, most controlled story-song. Direct was too thin.
Direct preserved the player-meta relationship without forcing official plot. Full brief and conditional were both acceptable but more literary and less immediate.
Conditional best expressed freedom being pulled back by human obligation. Full brief was coherent but generic. Direct was subtle but underpowered.
Direct gave the best ordinary-player self-portrait. Full brief was polished but generic. Conditional was singable but softer and less distinct.
Direct produced the clearest restrained night-drinking song with a memorable chorus mechanism. Full brief was correct but ordinary. Conditional was competent but less sharp.

decision.rationale: Conditional brief has almost the same median latency as direct mode in this 12-sample run, avoids the full-brief latency tax, and still recovers quality on short/entity-heavy story inputs such as Ruoshui. Direct mode is a valid fallback and often strongest for clear player-meta or intimate place inputs, but conditional gives a better safety net with little median cost.

do_not_use_default.reason: Quality is not consistently better, while total P50 is about 42.4s versus about 26s for direct/conditional.
Fast and often good, but weaker on short story/entity inputs where a brief can clarify the song entry.

decision.next_action: Keep public real-test default at LYRICS_FIRST_DRAFT_MODE=conditional-brief and LYRICS_QUALITY_GATE_MODE=self-score-only. Do not expand prompt rules now; next product test should validate user-perceived quality and first-draft latency in real browser flow.
